theme: Cash available exactly when it is needed
title: Liquidity Ladder: Smoothing the Rollover Cliff
strategies: dump-overnight baseline: borrow the entire funding need at the first maturity (always prefunding-safe, catastrophic single-date rollover exposure)
exact cashflow matching: place each maturity exactly where the legacy liability schedule falls due (zero prefunding slack, but reproduces the legacy schedule's own clustering)
uniform spread: split the funding need evenly across all maturities regardless of the legacy timing profile

worst-case hedge / smoothing: cap every date's maturing face value at its own haircut-adjusted safe capacity, forward-shifting only the excess into earlier dates with spare capacity, cheapest yield first
